title: Dom Santiago's last words in Gears of War 3
subject: dom
description:
Was Dom's sacrifice the right ending for him? 👇

How Dom Santiago's story ends in Gears of War 3, at the town of Mercy. Spoilers for Gears of War 3.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Xbox Game Studios or The Coalition. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Dom Santiago chose to die with his wife's name on his lips.
He had already lost his children, his brother Carlos, and finally Maria. Only Marcus was left.
At the town of Mercy, the squad was trapped, with enemies closing in from every side.
Dom spotted a fuel truck. He climbed in alone, and he didn't drive it away.
Aiming for a fuel tanker as Mad World played, he said: never thought it would end like this, huh? Huh, Maria?
The blast cleared the way. Marcus survived, and lost his brother.
